launch_local_jobs: launch a job group containing jobs with the Local executor and return execution handles
register_local_executor: register the local execution backend with the xmanager registry for Local executor type
launch_container_image: launch a preloaded Docker container image as a detached container with GPU support
launch_local_binary: launch a local binary as a detached process with merged args and environment variables
terminate_local_jobs: terminate all local jobs that were launched during the current session on process exit
